_readme: S523 SkyBarberry, 2026-10-30. Glendale course units, part a2. Part a (run 41007920360) printed pages 158-250 and priced 9 of its 19 courses; the ACCTG, ANTHR, ARCH, ART and AT descriptions sit before page 158 or are no longer printed, and no title keyword hit them. This read searches pages 100-160 for the code each description's body prints ('CAM 241 is an advanced Mastercam lathe course'). One load of the 2025-2026 PDF, no model call.
